TICKET
# Unefficient retreival of $this->id_lang in class Cart

I discovered this bug in Profiling mode, see screenshot :
![2021-11-29_100258](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143838392-e45b986d-508a-46a7-8a28-b1c82a3dfd68.jpg)
The class *Cart* instantiates 40x an object model *Language*, always the current language. Not only one time would suffice, but looking at the code, each time it is the code `$this->getAssociatedLanguage()->getId()` that is implicated.
`ObjectModel::getAssociatedLanguage` loads the Language object model referenced in `$this->id_lang` (see https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/classes/ObjectModel.php#L379), but we only use the id of that model.

The bug consist of using `$this->getAssociatedLanguage()->getId()` instead of the straight forward `$this->id_lang`.

## Attendu
I expect that when an object property is directly accessible, like `$this->id_lang`, we use it, instead of going for a convoluted, ressource intensive solution.

## Étapes
1. Enable Profiling mode
2. Display a FO page while having an article in the cart
3. Scroll down to Profiling section *ObjectModel instances*
4. Notice the number of times a language object model is instantiated (43x in my case, of which 40x in `classes/Cart.php`)
